# SellerWala

> Free, browser-based tools for Indian e-commerce sellers. Nothing is uploaded to a server,
> no account is required, and there are no watermarks, page limits, or paid tiers.

SellerWala is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by
Meesho, Flipkart, Amazon, or any marketplace. All processing happens locally in the visitor's
browser using JavaScript and WebAssembly; uploaded files never leave the device.

## Tools

- [Meesho Label Cropper](https://sellerwala.com/tools/meesho-label-cropper): Takes the shipping
  label PDF downloaded from the Meesho Supplier Panel and produces a print-ready file. Crops the
  attached tax invoice away (or saves it separately), resizes for 3x5" and 4x6" thermal label
  printers or packs 1, 2, or 4 labels onto an A4 sheet, sorts by SKU, courier, pickup hub, or
  colour and size, optionally stamps custom text or the order number, and generates a SKU pick
  list showing how many of each item to pack. Handles labels from any Meesho courier, including
  Valmo, Delhivery, Shadowfax, Xpressbees, and Ecom Express.

- [Meesho Profit Calculator](https://sellerwala.com/tools/meesho-profit-calculator): Reads the
  payment file from Supplier Panel → Payments → Download → Payments to Date and works out actual
  profit. Uses the Final Settlement Amount, so marketplace commission, shipping, and GST
  deductions are already accounted for. The seller adds per-SKU listing, making, and packing
  costs, plus business overheads (rent, salary, bills), which are prorated across the payment
  window. Reports per-SKU margin, RTO and return write-offs, and a profit waterfall. Meesho's
  own panel does not provide a true profit figure, which is why this exists.

## Key facts

- Price: free. No login, no email, no subscription.
- Privacy: files are processed client-side and never transmitted. No server receives them.
- Platforms: Meesho is fully supported. Amazon and Flipkart croppers are on the roadmap.
- Audience: Indian marketplace sellers, primarily small and mid-sized Meesho suppliers.
